name: uml_diagram_generate
description: Generate focused UML diagrams for a repository, directory, module, or symbol scope.

inputs.scope_kind: One of repo, directory, module, symbol.
inputs.target: Scope target path/module/symbol. Omit for repo scope.
inputs.include_methods: Whether class methods should be listed in focused class diagrams.
inputs.neighbor_depth: Expansion depth for dependency neighborhood around the scope.
inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory. Defaults to Docs/uml/scopes/<scope>.

outputs.component_puml: PlantUML component overview for the selected scope.
outputs.dependency_mmd: Mermaid dependency flow for the selected scope.
outputs.class_puml: PlantUML class diagram for the selected scope.
outputs.index_md: Markdown index for the generated diagram set.
